assign.request: work on a right column navigation system: it's like a right property sidebar, where the right sidebar remains persistent. when you click an item in this right column tree, it switches the main (center) content area to be the new page.
steps: build rightnav/page.js: persistent tree + swap centre
build 3+ child pages s/m/xl content sizes
wire nested expand_more items in tree
build variant toolbar: width/side/placement/400-collapse with store()

log.msg: built page.js + rightnav.css at public/imagine/paging/rightnav/: five real leaves (s/m/xl plus a Guides branch of two), a mode toolbar (width/side/placement) via store(), reusing paging.css/.js vocabulary (paging-item, paging-panel, paging-toolbar, paging-card/box, paging-wall)

found and fixed a real bug: imagine/ is a columns host, and column_host() finds it from any depth, so core own render_column() clobbers a hand-set this.$pages right after content() returns - a leaf mounted in core page-column-pages instead of my own centre box. Fixed by calling Page.prototype.render.call(this) then re-asserting this.$pages = this.$centre. Documented in doc/decisions.md

ui-test at 1280: clicked Paragraph/Wall/Word/Contract in turn - url and h2 content changed every time, tree+centre rect held dh:0 across all four swaps after switching the row to a fixed height; expanded Guides branch revealed Contract/Seams in place; toggled wide/left/outside toolbar chips live. Zero console errors across 27 steps. Screenshots at 400 (collapsed to an icon-only bar) and 3440 also clean, zero errors

assign.outcome:
**Landed:** a persistent right tree + swapping centre at `/imagine/paging/rightnav/` -- five real leaves (three content sizes `s`/`m`/`xl`, plus two nested under a `Guides` branch that expands in place), a three-axis mode toolbar (tree width narrow/wide, side right/left, placement inside/outside) remembered by `store()`, built entirely from words the program already has (`.paging-item` `.paging-panel` `.paging-toolbar` `.paging-card`/`.paging-box` `.paging-wall` from `../paging.css`/`.js`).

A real bug found and fixed along the way: `/imagine/` is a columns host and `column_host()` finds it from any depth, so core's own `render_column()` silently clobbers a hand-set `this.$pages` right after `content()` returns -- a leaf mounted in core's own `page-column-pages` box instead of mine. Fixed by calling `Page.prototype.render.call(this)` then re-asserting `this.$pages = this.$centre` -- full writeup in `doc/decisions.md`.
